package gorm

// DB stands in for gorm's own, carrying the one method this rule names. The
// stand-in is what lets the typed pass run offline: the probe module resolves
// gorm.io/gorm to this package through a local replace, so no download and no
// module cache are involved in deciding whose method a call reaches.
type DB struct{}

func (db *DB) AutoMigrate(dst ...any) error { return nil }
